acceptance: AUTH: actual managed-session checkpoint rejects absent/revoked/expired/policy-unsupported and cross-project identities.
PROVENANCE: all adopted source groups include complete historical states and identities; unknown/hidden/missing sources deny.
FENCE: every relevant writer is cooperatively serialized or independently contained; lease expiry cannot reopen source while Core outcome uncertain.
ATOMIC_CORE: Company, Owner, portal/reservation, proof consumption, receipt/outbox and append-only audit commit or abort together.
ATOMIC_STOCK: tenant/profile/private binding and canonical audit commit or abort together; Auth effects are separate and quarantined on failure.
REPLAY: exact retry under current authority returns original result; changed payload, foreign tenant, duplicate identity and revoked authority deny.
E2_E3: independent exact proof and two independent authorized current operator sessions required; cannot pass E1.
FIRST_CHECKOUT: reserved Stock portal can precede local profile; no access until exact current canonical binding and entitlement verified.
RECOVERY: independent observer verifies baseline/fixture outcomes and no active residue without deleting protected audit.
NO_RELEASE: application flags and fixed refusals unchanged; no Production, paid services, SSO or real payment.
